title: Anthropic’s IPO could deliver $156B to charity
lede: TechCrunch estimates Anthropic's IPO could route about $156 billion to charity through its Public Benefit Fund, employee share pledges and the company's matching of those pledges.

points: The Public Benefit Fund received 5% of shares, almost 850 million, worth about $80 billion at a price near $95.
It gains another 2% each time the valuation climbs more than 50% above the $83 IPO price; its first grant was $200 million to study AI's effect on workers.
Employees have pledged an estimated $23 billion in shares, which Anthropic matches 3-to-1 for longer-tenured staff and 1-to-1 for newer ones, about $53 billion more.
The total would be roughly a quarter of the $617 billion Americans gave to charity in 2025.
Pledges still have to be honored, some shares may sit in donor-advised funds, and much is expected to go to EA-aligned groups and AI safety research.
